summary_text: UK indie-pop artist with 980K monthly listeners at signing. Strong Spotify playlist presence, 12 active markets, significant UK and US traction. Signed to Premium Solutions. Grew to 3.4M peak listeners within 18 months. High energy alt-pop with festival appeal.

UK/Australian alt-pop group with 1.1M monthly listeners at signing. Strong press coverage including NME and DIY Magazine. Active in 14 markets. Grew to 2.8M peak listeners. Premium Solutions signing with full marketing support in UK and Australia.

French indie-pop artist with 760K monthly listeners at signing. Limited press coverage initially. Strong domestic market with growing European presence. Currently at 1.6M listeners and still developing. Premium Solutions with focus on European expansion.

German techno producer with 2.2M monthly listeners at signing. Resident Advisor and Mixmag coverage. 22 active markets, strong European electronic scene presence. Grew to 5.1M peak listeners. Premium Solutions, b.electronic label. Major Boiler Room and Fabric presence.

French melodic techno artist with 1.8M monthly listeners at signing. Strong Resident Advisor and electronic press credibility. 19 active markets. Currently at 4.3M listeners. Premium Solutions, Believe's flagship electronic artist.

Norwegian industrial techno producer with 1.4M monthly listeners at signing. Fabric and DC10 residencies. Strong Resident Advisor credibility. Grew to 2.9M listeners. Premium Solutions, focus on European festival circuit.

French rap superstar with 3.5M monthly listeners at signing. Dominant domestic presence, top seller in France for multiple consecutive years. Premium Solutions, Believe's flagship French rap artist. Grew to 12M peak listeners.

French trap artist, led album sales in France two consecutive years. 1.2M monthly listeners at signing. Strong streaming performance with loyal domestic fanbase. Grew to 4.8M peak listeners under Believe Premium Solutions support.
Ghanaian afrobeats artist with 290K monthly listeners at signing. UK and US diaspora traction. Currently at 680K listeners and growing. Premium Solutions focusing on African and UK market expansion.

Nigerian afrobeats artist with 410K monthly listeners and 11 tier-1 press articles at signing. Strong UK presence, BET coverage. Grew to 1.8M peak listeners. Premium Solutions with successful UK and US market push.

US-based afro-hip-hop artist with 180K monthly listeners at signing. Minimal press coverage, limited market reach. Never exceeded 240K listeners. Dropped after 12 months. Low market diversity and declining trajectory were warning signs.

Indian pop/bollywood artist with 850K monthly listeners at signing. Strong Indian market dominance with growing Southeast Asian presence. Grew to 3.2M peak listeners. Believe's flagship Indian artist.

Mexican latin-pop artist with 1.5M monthly listeners at signing. 18 active markets, strong Latin American and US Hispanic market. Grew to 5.8M peak listeners. Premium Solutions, focus on pan-Latin market strategy.
French ambient electronic artist, part of Believe's in-house label development. 320K monthly listeners at signing. Growing through editorial playlists. Currently developing at 890K listeners.

Punjabi music powerhouse acquired by Believe in 2024. 620K monthly listeners at catalog acquisition. Strong diaspora markets in UK, Canada, UAE. Grew to 2.1M peak listeners. Believe's flagship Punjabi label.

US trap artist, TuneCore self-distribution success story. 95K monthly listeners at onboarding. Strong DIY ethos, consistent release cadence. Grew to 450K listeners independently. TuneCore Automated Solutions.
German bedroom-pop artist, TuneCore distribution. 75K monthly listeners. Strong Instagram presence relative to streaming. Growing slowly but consistently. Currently at 220K listeners.
Brazilian latin-urban artist with 680K monthly listeners at signing. Strong domestic and pan-Latin market. Grew to 2.6M peak listeners. Premium Solutions, Believe's Brazilian success story.
German death metal band, Nuclear Blast roster. 520K monthly listeners at signing. Kerrang! and Metal Hammer coverage. 16 active markets. Grew to 1.4M peak listeners. Nuclear Blast Premium Solutions.
UK-based afrobeats artist, TuneCore distribution. 230K monthly listeners at onboarding, limited market reach. Flat trajectory. Left TuneCore after 8 months. Declining streaming were warning signs.

Argentine latin-alternative artist. 410K monthly listeners at signing. Growing regional presence across South America. Currently at 1.1M listeners. Premium Solutions focus on Latin American and US Hispanic expansion.
Japanese city-pop artist, part of Believe's new PlayCode imprint launch in Japan. 180K monthly listeners at signing. Strong domestic YouTube presence. Currently developing at 520K listeners.

French neo-soul R&B artist. 340K monthly listeners at signing. Les Inrockuptibles coverage. Strong streaming editorial playlist support. Grew to 1.2M peak listeners. Premium Solutions, AllPoints label distribution.

UK techno-house producer. 890K monthly listeners at signing. Data Transmission and Mixmag coverage. Strong Fabric and Printworks association. Grew to 2.4M peak listeners. Premium Solutions, b.electronic label.

US dream-pop band. 520K monthly listeners at signing. Pitchfork coverage. Failed to maintain momentum after signing. Peaked at 610K listeners and declined. Premium Solutions investment did not produce sufficient growth. Dropped after 14 months.
